meta.title: WeChat snapshot and conversation service
meta.description: Provides strictly validated read-only snapshot and connection actions for the native sidebar. No reads or networking by default. Independent decrypted copies require explicit Session grants, and WeChat connection and messaging need separate confirmations.

historySourceFailed: Could not read this source. Retry or import WeChat history again.
historyEmptyHint: Try another keyword. Import history again to add the new sources.
historyMiniScope: Mini-program cards, titles, links and extracted text from chats and favorites.
historyFavoritesScope: Favorite content and origin. Dates use the favorite database update time.
historyContactsScope: Contact remarks, display names and WeChat IDs.
historyVoiceScope: Transcribe a selected voice locally. The next history update adds its text to search.
historyModelVision: Use the current model to understand selected images and video frames
historyTranscriptCitation: View voice record and transcript citation
historyBatchHint: Automatic history updates process local transcription, OCR and indexing in idle batches.
historyBatchProgress: Local batch index: {processed} processed, {skipped} unavailable records skipped.
